[U] / [CO2] if statement: Executes a block if the condition is true x = 10 if x > 5: print("x is greater than 5") if–else statement: Executes one block if the condition true, another if false if x % 2 == 0: print("Even") else: print("Odd") Nested if: One if inside another. if x > 0: if x < 10: print("x is between 1 and 9") if–elif ladder: Multiple conditions checked sequentially. if x < 0: print("Negative") elif x == 0: print("Zero") else: print("Positive")
